schema.alpha, k, n, delta: calibration: δ = k-th smallest m_i over the n calibration items, k = floor(alpha*(n+1)); "inf" = +infinity
schema.calibration_log: one entry per fixed-point iteration of the calib-split pass (see scripts/run_phase4.py)
schema.spoken_error_items[]: every line item labelled 'error' (calib and test, all sources): source v1|v2|v3|rec, split, id, line, test (bool), m_i (min Delta over valid candidates not SymEq-equal to what was said; 0 if c_hat is valid and different; "inf" if none), c_hat_valid_and_different, excluded_qc (qc_wer>0), in_calibration, record
schema.mishearing_items[]: every valid/follows_error line item whose c_hat differs from what was said: source, split, id, line, test, label, hat_status, detectable (c_hat checker status error), fixed_at_calibrated_delta, record
schema.record: {line, label, source, c_hat{status, eq_said}, cands[{delta, valid, eq_said, cls}]}: feed to src.calibrate.simulate(record, delta) to recompute the decision at any δ (statuses were checked against the previous output of the calibrated run). Calib error records come from the final calib-split pass; everything else from the calibrated all-source run.
schema.SCR at δ: share of test spoken-error items with simulate(...).status in {verified, corrected} and not out_eq_said; bound event: m_i < δ
schema.fix rate at δ: share of test mishearing items with simulate(...).out_eq_said
